question1.title: What does the financial summary contain?
question1.answer: The summary displays your sales, purchases, fees, withdrawals and net result for the month. Each category is automatically calculated and color-coded for quick reading.

question2.title: How does advanced search work?
question2.answer: Use the search field to filter your transactions by title, amount, date or type. Automatic categorization helps you quickly identify different types of operations.

question3.title: What does the CSV export contain?
question3.answer: All displayed transactions with their date, type, amount, description, status... Excel compatible and ideal for your accountant.

question4.title: What does the PDF report look like?
question4.answer: A professional document with your monthly summary, evolution charts, and transaction details. Perfect for your tax returns or personal tracking.

question5.title: How to navigate between months?
question5.answer: An intuitive popup allows you to quickly select any month. The summary and exports automatically adapt to the chosen period.

question6.title: How to receive the extension after purchase?
question6.answer: You will immediately receive a download link by email with detailed installation instructions.
